request: Inspect receiver Compose identity for safe targeted rebuild and writer restart

bounded_host_request.command: set -e; cd /home/admin1/server-core; docker inspect --format 'PROJECT={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}} SERVICE={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}} IMAGE={{.Config.Image}} USER={{.Config.User}}' server-core-bounded-host; docker inspect --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Destination .Type}}{{end}}' server-core-bounded-host; docker inspect --format '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' server-core-bounded-host; docker compose version; printf 'PROJECT_CONTROL='; docker ps --filter name=server-core-project-control --format '{{.Names}}'; printf 'SYSTEMD_RUN='; command -v systemd-run; printf 'READER_SCRIPT='; test -f scripts/servercore_host_output_read.py && echo yes
